whoosh: a fast sharp whoosh of a wooden staff swung through the air
swoosh-big: a big fast swoosh of something flying past through the air
hit: a single heavy punch impact thud, cartoon fight hit
clang: a metal staff strikes a bull horn, a sharp heavy clang impact
crash: a body slams into a wooden wall, heavy crash with wood cracking and debris falling
crumble: small rocks and plaster crumble and fall to the ground
land: a heavy animal lands hard on a wooden floor, a deep thud
boom: a deep booming shockwave impact with a rumble
leap: a quick jump whoosh upward, cloth fluttering
